entries.title: Intermediate Mass Black Holes; Meteor Showers or Space Debris?
entries.description: In this talk, we explore how changes in visible gas emission lines over nearly two decades cannbsp;reveal these hidden engines, highlighting recent Magellan Spectrograph observations of dwarf galaxy J1143 that point to an accretingnbsp;intermediate-mass black hole at its core.
entries.priorTitleZh: 中等质量黑洞；流星雨还是太空碎片？
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 本次讲座将探讨近二十年来可见气体发射线的变化如何揭示隐藏的能量来源，并介绍 Magellan 光谱仪对矮星系 J1143 的最新观测；相关结果表明其核心可能存在一个正在吸积的中等质量黑洞。

entries.title: The Rhinoceros Project Sewing Circles
entries.description: Join The Rhinoceros Project with artists Michelle Wilson andnbsp;Anne Beck for community sewing circles where participantsnbsp;help create embroidered maps connecting Palo Alto tonbsp;historic routes across California and Mexico.The ArtLift Grant Program supports temporary projects bynbsp;local artists and creatives, fostering connection, joy, andnbsp;community engagement.Workshop
